stash.ask.apart: It changes none of the files you have changed.
stash.ask.body: Apply "{message}" on top of your uncommitted changes?
stash.ask.overlap.one: It changes a file you have changed too, so Git may stop with conflicts or refuse to apply:
stash.ask.overlap.other: It changes {count} files you have changed too, so Git may stop with conflicts or refuse to apply:
stash.ask.pop_kept: If it conflicts, the stash is kept.
stash.ask.unknown: If they change the same files, Git may stop with conflicts or refuse to apply.
stash.blocked.conflicted: Resolve the conflicted files before stashing.
stash.blocked.conflicts: Resolve the conflicted files first: Git can't apply a stash while files are conflicted.
stash.blocked.no_files: Choose at least one file to stash.
stash.blocked.nothing: There are no changes to stash.
stash.blocked.nothing_staged: Nothing is staged. Stage the changes to set aside first, or choose another option.
stash.push.keep_index.help: Staged changes go into the stash and also stay staged, ready to commit.
stash.push.keep_index.staged_tip: Can't be combined with stashing only the staged changes.
stash.push.rename_blocked.toast: Nothing was stashed: move the file blocking a staged rename, or keep staged changes.
